units_checked.description: ids (Rd file paths) of every unit in your batch that you actually read

unit.description: the Rd file path, exactly as the unit id in the batch

text.description: one or two sentences: what is wrong and the evidence (file:line)

source_file.description: the R/EDI/R/*.R file holding the roxygen text

old_sentence.description: spelling or grammar: the whole sentence copied exactly from the roxygen source, without the #-quote prefixes

new_sentence.description: spelling or grammar: the same sentence, corrected

changes_claim.description: true if the new sentence states something different from the old one

example_block.description: example-fix: the complete new @examples section as plain text, one line per code line, WITHOUT the leading #-quote prefixes and WITHOUT the @examples tag line

cause.description: example-fix: one line, why the old example failed

dontrun_reason.description: example-fix: why the new block uses dontrun; none if it does not

plain_part_reason.description: example-fix: only if the new block has no code outside donttest and dontrun, why no fast plain part is possible; else empty
